RFC5575-4-1.note: RFC 5575 Section 4: "Implementations wishing to exchange flow specification rules MUST use BGP's Capability Advertisement facility to exchange the Multiprotocol Extension Capability Code (Code 1) as defined in RFC 4760 [RFC4760]." RFC 8955 Section 4 restates this obligation; the existing superseded disposition is retained. TestIPv4FlowSpecNegotiatesMultiprotocolCapability is only registration/constructed-capability evidence. The current reactor/rfc5575_capability_wire_test.go TestRFC5575OpenCapabilityMatchesTransmittedFlowFamily additionally decodes buildOpen OptionalParams produced from real parsed configuration, verifies Code-1 families, and sends through AnnounceNLRIBatch. Matching SAFI sends exactly the required MP_REACH bytes; advertising only the other FlowSpec SAFI returns ErrNoPeersAcceptedFamily and writes zero bytes. Producers session_negotiate.go buildOpen, capability.Negotiate and reactor_api_batch.go AnnounceNLRIBatch/buildBatchAnnounceUpdate were read. Distinct matched/mismatched negotiation arms are a genuine positive/negative pair. Removed only the now-false single-polarity annotation. Independent source rejudgment only; no test, mutation, build or gate was executed by this auditor. Native observed-red renewal is a separate parent step.

RFC5575-4-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-16 after the codec moved to internal/core/bgp/nlri/flowspec; the two types_test units changed only by package qualification. RFC 5575 Section 4: "The (AFI, SAFI) pair carried in the Multiprotocol Extension Capability MUST be the same as the one used to identify a particular application that uses this NLRI-type." TestFlowSpecIPv4Basic/TestFlowSpecVPNFamily pin the plugin-registered families (register.go family.MustRegister) to AFI 1/SAFI 133 and AFI 1-2/SAFI 134. The proof is the reactor unit TestRFC5575OpenCapabilityMatchesTransmittedFlowFamily: for flow and flow-vpn it requires the configured OPEN to advertise the pair, requires the MP_REACH AFI/SAFI and NLRI to equal it exactly through AnnounceNLRIBatch, and with the crossed SAFI negotiated requires ErrNoPeersAcceptedFamily and zero bytes written. Scoped go test of core flowspec, plugin flowspec, message and flowspec-firewall packages green on this tree.

RFC5575-4-3.note: Re-judged 2026-10-16 after the codec move; units changed only by package qualification. RFC 5575 Section 4: "Flow specification components must follow strict type ordering." TestFlowSpecComponentsAscendingOrder adds types 5,12,3,1 and requires the re-parsed wire order 1,3,5,12 (red on insertion-order emission by core writeComponentsSorted); TestFlowSpecJoinsRepeatedTypeIntoOneComponent requires one Type 4 component with exact merged bytes; TestParseFlowSpecRefusesRepeatedComponentType requires ErrFlowSpecDuplicateType from core parseComponents on a repeated type 4, with the merged control accepted.

RFC5575-4-4.note: Re-judged 2026-10-16 after the codec move; units changed only by package qualification. RFC 5575 Section 4: "if present, it MUST precede any component of higher numeric type value." Positive asserts strictly ascending emitted types and the exact order 1,3,5,12; negative TestParseFlowSpecRefusesDescendingComponentType requires ErrFlowSpecTypeOrder from core parseComponents on 5-then-3, with the same components ascending accepted, so the refusal is isolated to order.

RFC5575-4-8.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 (independent auditor, authored none of 4f0134cacd). RFC 5575 Section 4: "Whenever the corresponding application does not require Next-Hop information, this shall be encoded as a 0-octet length Next Hop in the MP_REACH_NLRI attribute and ignored on receipt." 4f0134cacd changed one line of TestFlowSpecForwardingOmitsNextHop: the drive is now forwardViaRIB, which forwards the received UPDATE live (that rail keeps no FlowSpec rule since 4f0134cacd) and then relays each rule through the real reactorAPIAdapter.RelayStoredRoute with the received attribute block and generation, the way rs replays the RIB's ValidationChange. That is the one rail a received FlowSpec rule now leaves by, so the test follows the product rather than a retired path. Assertions unchanged and exact: exactly one recipient UPDATE per case, and assertFlowForwardWire compares the whole MP_REACH value to AFI/SAFI/len 0/reserved/NLRI with the traffic-rate action intact, across unchanged, self, explicit4 and explicit6 next-hop modes and empty, peer-address and IPv6 received hops; a relay that kept or rewrote the hop, or dropped the rule, fails. The helper builds the StoredRoute itself rather than through rs, so rs's own construction is covered by TestFlowSpecRouteServerOmitsNextHop, unchanged. The two revert records on this unit (applyNextHopFamily, payloadNextHop) were re-taken over the relay drive. Other carriers (wire contract, origination, rib receive-ignore) unchanged. Verdict stands.

RFC5575-5.1-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: both units moved verbatim to internal/core/bgp/nlri/flowspec, only the family identifier changed to the test-local ipv4FlowSpec literal (AFI 1, SAFI 133). RFC 5575 Section 5.1: "This ordering function must be such that it must not depend on the arrival order of the flow specification's rules and must be constant in the network." TestFlowSpecPrecedenceFromWire requires Compare(a,b)<0, Compare(b,a)>0 and Compare(a,a)==0 over overlap, disjoint, component-type, operator-byte, received-width and extra-component pairs; TestRFC5575PrecedenceIndependentOfArrival parses independent copies in both arrival orders, sorts with production Compare and requires identical exact byte order. Compare (core compare.go) reads only component content, no identity or arrival metadata.

RFC5575-7-1.note: Forbidden: non-zero bytes in the five octets before the DSCP, or the DSCP elsewhere. TestFlowSpecTrafficMarkingReservedBytesZero asserts ec[2..6]==0 and ec[7]==dscp with type 0x80/0x09; red on either. {single-polarity} marker present.

RFC5575-8-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit changed only in how the VPN family is named (family.Family{AFIIPv4, SAFIFlowSpecVPN} instead of the plugin constant). RFC 5575 Section 8: "The NLRI length field shall include both the 8 bytes of the Route Distinguisher as well as the subsequent flow specification." TestFlowSpecVPNUpdateCountsRouteDistinguisher builds a VPN UPDATE through the real message builder and requires the exact MP_REACH NLRI 13|RD|5-octet value (red on a length of 5) with SAFI 134, re-parses it, and requires the core ParseFlowSpecVPN to error when the length octet is reduced by 8.
